description_en: Adds a specified entity object to a Data Map collection. The collection object can be a Data Map category or a data album. The entity object currently supports only the data table type. To add an entity to a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission, or be the creator or administrator of the album
description_zh:
向数据地图集合中添加给定实体对象，集合对象支持数据地图类目和数据专辑两种，实体对象当前仅支持数据表类型。
向数据专辑添加实体时，要求调用者具有AliyunDataWorksFullAccess 权限，或者为专辑的创建者或管理员
name: AddEntityIntoMetaCollection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collection object. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListMetaCollections operation
parameters.help_zh: 集合对象Id，可参考ListMetaCollections接口返回结果
parameters.name: meta_collection_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity. Currently, only the table type is supported. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListTables operation
parameters.help_zh: 实体Id，目前仅支持表类型，可参考ListTables接口返回结果
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The remarks when adding the entity to the collection. Currently, this parameter takes effect only for the album type
parameters.help_zh:
添加到集合时的备注信息，
目前仅对专辑类型生效
parameters.name: remark
